faqs.question: What is the best way to add air conditioning to an older Pelzer home without ducts?
faqs.answer: Ductless mini-splits, in most cases. They deliver efficient heating and cooling room by room without the cost and wall damage of retrofitting duct runs.

faqs.question: My lights dim when the HVAC kicks on. Is that dangerous?
faqs.answer: A brief flicker at compressor start is common, but pronounced or worsening dimming deserves diagnosis. It can indicate an overloaded panel, a weak connection, or a compressor drawing hard at startup.

faqs.question: Should I replace my water heater before it fails or run it until it quits?
faqs.answer: Age and location decide. A tank past its expected span installed above finished space is a flood planning to happen, and replacing on your schedule beats replacing on its.

faqs.question: Do small recurring leaks in older pipes actually mean anything?
faqs.answer: Yes, they are data. Leaks scattered across different sections indicate the material itself aging out, and each repair buys progressively less time.

faqs.question: Do your routes cover the communities around Pelzer?
faqs.answer: They do. Williamston, Piedmont, and Powdersville share the same dispatch, and the chat team can verify any Anderson County address.
